About Us

Ali & Othman International General Trading & Contracting is a Kuwait based company providing building and air conditioning maintenance services. We work with homes and facilities from site inspection through execution and ongoing maintenance.

Maintenance solutions for homes and facilities

Our work covers air conditioning, duct cleaning, electrical systems and plumbing. We define the right scope by understanding the site and its requirements.
